title: Independent reproduction and adjudication of W006-R03-SCOPE-01 (stage-B R03 scope-safety corpus)

independence.basis: non-author (worker-006) and non-owner; worker-084 did not build the scope corpus, the R03 candidates or the frozen rule; every tool executed as a subprocess; labels and oracle written in this verifier's PREREGISTRATION.json before any fixture was run
declared_limits: same durable worker id built FORM-HELDOUT-10; no held-out byte is read or modified by this task and no held-out result is cited
the rules are executed, not re-implemented; this adjudicates the corpus, the pins, the declared cell matrix and the published aggregates
scope-safety is established only for this 14-scored-cell corpus (one class, one slot, one rule family)

method.cells: 4 candidates x (19 fixtures + 3 live canonicals) = 88 cells, each re-executed into raw/
method.determinism_check: artifacts/worker-084/r03v2_scope_indep/check_determinism.py (88 cells re-executed into raw_pass2/); 0 field differences
method.mutation_target_check: recursive flattening diff of each fixture against its declared base

verdict_basis: C1-C8 all pass plus two extra integrity checks (88/88 second-pass determinism; 76/76 declared-expectation cells with 0 deviations). The published headline (frozen FP4/FN2; cand_r03v2 FP0/FN0 and accepts all three live canonicals; cand_004 FP0/FN7; cand_E3 FP0/FN8) reproduces exactly under a non-author, non-owner driver.

findings.finding: Exact reproduction: 88/88 cells agree with the published raw_verdicts.json on returncode, verdict, failed_rules and doc_sha256, and the whole matrix is deterministic on a second pass (88/88). No cell produced a non-R03 failed rule.

The corpus labels are independently confirmed: the verifier re-derived all 19 labels from the frozen binder semantics (6 pos / 8 neg / 4 edge / 1 identical control) with 19/19 agreement, and a deterministic literal-token oracle reproduces the frozen verdict on 19/19 fixtures, confirming that the frozen FP/FN pattern is literal-match mechanics, not a scoring artifact.

Wording understatement in the subject claim: cand_r03v2 rejects 4/4 interpretation-dependent edge probes (comma-coordinated binder, long filler span, split/nested quantifiers, brace-group notation), while the claim names only 'two pre-declared over-rejects'. All four were declared v2:reject in the manifest, so the declared-expectation matrix has 0 deviations and no scored cell is affected; an adopter should nonetheless not read cand_r03v2 as accepting nested-quantifier or brace-group renderings.
findings.falsifier: A cand_r03v2 revision that accepts edge_split_quantifiers.yaml or edge_braces_group.yaml, or a manifest that declares fewer than four v2 edge rejections.

findings.finding: Scope limit: scope-safety is measured on one class (AF-WCC-VAC-GEN), one slot (quantifiers.formal), one rule family (R03) and 14 scored cells. The author's own next falsifier (a later held-out scope corpus) remains open and is not discharged here.

Governance: stage-B (artifacts/worker-06/spec_conformance_audit.py) is not pinned in FROZEN rev29. Any adoption of cand_r03v2 must pin both the adopted tool hash (e41a4b23a840) and the rule module (c572a033c054) in the same revision, or gate-relevant evidence can change with no pinned byte moving.
findings.falsifier: An adoption that changes the stage-B tool hash without a FROZEN pin in the same revision.

falsifier_outcome: None of the pre-registered falsifiers triggered: no pinned byte moved before or after either pass; 0/88 cells disagreed with the published raw; all fixture bytes matched the manifest; every mutant changed only quantifiers.formal; no genuine binding error was accepted or correct rendering rejected beyond the published counts; no repair candidate rejected a live canonical; no non-R03 failed rule occurred; raw JSON was reproducible on a second pass.
falsifier: Any pinned byte moving during the run; any of the 88 cells disagreeing with the published raw; a fixture hash mismatch; a changed path outside quantifiers.formal; a scored FP/FN count differing from the published counts; a repair candidate rejecting a live canonical; a non-R03 failed rule; or non-reproducible raw JSON.
do_not_claim: No gate verdict, no node completion, no theorem, no adoption decision, no claim that cand_r03v2 is correct beyond this 19-fixture corpus. Independent measurement evidence only.
